secret.description: Gustav Wehrle drinks alone in the Bar from 9:30 PM to 10:00 PM and will claim to have been anywhere else.

motive.description: was about to be exposed by the victim

people.name: Daniel Hanrahan
people.role: a travelling salesman in patent medicines

secret.description: Daniel Hanrahan is with Mary Kavanagh in the Service Stairs from 6:30 PM to 7:30 PM, and both will say they were somewhere else.
Percival Dandridge hands a parcel of stolen goods to a man at the Kitchen at 10:00 PM.

people.name: Mary Kavanagh
people.role: a wine steward out of work since the Act

secret.description: Mary Kavanagh is with Daniel Hanrahan in the Service Stairs from 6:30 PM to 7:30 PM, and both will say they were somewhere else.

people.name: Hyman Hurwitz
people.role: a dentist with rooms on the third floor

secret.description: Hyman Hurwitz meets the victim alone in the Victim's Suite from 7:30 PM and asks for money.

people.name: Rachel Kessler
people.role: a photographer for the rotogravure section

secret.description: Rachel Kessler is alone with Sadie Lefkowitz in the Roof Garden from 9:00 PM to 10:00 PM, and kills Sadie Lefkowitz at 10:00 PM.

motive.description: wanted the victim out of a lease

method.name: a push from the roof garden

Sadie Lefkowitz was found in the Roof Garden. The coroner puts death between 9:30 PM and 10:00 PM. Fractures consistent with a fall of six storeys. Two fingernails torn back.
The roof door key is missing from the Front Desk. The roof door was found unlocked and the key is not on its hook.
Rain began at 8:00 PM and did not let up. Anyone out on the street after that came back in wet.
Antonio Grasso says the bar radio carried a six-day bicycle race from the Velodrome at 8:30 PM, and that a rider fell at the bank and the lead changed hands. Anyone in the bar could tell you that.
Found in the Victim's Suite: A typed page of dates and sums in Sadie Lefkowitz's file, headed with Gustav Wehrle's name.
Wilhelm Obermann says Sadie Lefkowitz told Gustav Wehrle that the story would run whether Gustav Wehrle liked it or not.
Found in the Victim's Suite: A lease assignment made out in Rachel Kessler's name, waiting only on Sadie Lefkowitz's signature.
Antonio Grasso says Sadie Lefkowitz told Rachel Kessler the lease would go to somebody else at the quarter day.
